messages.subject: geomorph 3.0.7 available on CRAN
parts:
Fellow morphometricians,

 

I wish to inform you that geomorph 3.0.7 is up and available on the CRAN repository. Just a few minor changes, which, as always, are described in the NEWS file and respective function help files.

 

The most noticeable difference is that readland.tps now prompts the user to specify whether negative landmark coordinates represent missing values, or whether they are actual negative coordinates (the former being how TPSDig codes missing landmarks).

 

Best,

 

Dean and the geomorph team

 

Dr. Dean C. Adams

Director of Graduate Education, EEB Program

Professor

Department of Ecology, Evolution, and Organismal Biology

Iowa State University

www.public.iastate.edu/~dcadams/

phone: 515-294-3834
